global_rules: Every displayed KMP value is extracted from the named real tool response; hooks, user prompts and CTAs are terminal say events, never product output.
Every process uses the campaign binary SHA-256 and an isolated campaign store; no user memory is opened.
The OBS scheduler executes the matching edl.json obs_schedule on the same monotonic clock as the PTY and MCP wire.
No promoted capture may use Codex, Claude, Agent A or Agent B branding; the fallback identity is Process A/B.
No scene may use red host or plugin treatment; red is reserved for genuine product state and must not appear as editorial error chrome.
The final hold contains no new product action or audio cue.
